qualifications: All analysis relies solely on the provided packet as instructed. No external market, appraisal or borrower information was used.
Rent roll provides market rents for vacant units for context only; they are not included in contractual rent or EGI except as directed by the underwriting plan.
Historical T12 is cash-basis and may not directly reconcile to the point-in-time rent roll; differences are expected and disclosed.
Management fee minimum and reserve assumptions are applied exactly as stated; no additional operating normalizations were made beyond those listed in the plan.
Prepayment friction is quoted from the term sheet; actual loan documents may differ at closing.
arguments.summary: Sized a 5-year fixed-rate refinance per the term sheet. Underwritten NOI before reserves is $647,395 and NCF after reserves is $631,795. Indicative value at 5.75% cap is $11.259 million. LTV cap is $6.755 million, DSCR cap is $6.407 million (binding), and debt yield cap is $7.020 million. Maximum loan $6.407 million results in first-year IO debt service of $400,468 and cash to borrower of about $1.78 million after a 1% origination fee and $65,000 costs. Downside sizing with EGI -5% and sizing rate +100 bps yields $5.339 million (DSCR). Workbook with live formulas and memo PDF are included.
